methodologyNotes: Covers adult bicycle helmets sold at a published US MSRP, including road, mountain, gravel, and commuter/urban lids. Excludes children's helmets, full-face DH/BMX helmets, motorcycle and ski helmets, and smart helmets whose defining feature is electronics. Price is manufacturer MSRP in USD for the standard colorway. weightGrams is the manufacturer's claimed weight in grams for a size Medium (or the brand's single/one-size figure); null if only non-Medium weights are published. rotationalProtection is the rotational-impact system as an enum: 'MIPS', 'MIPS Air', 'MIPS Spherical', 'WaveCel', 'SPIN', 'Koroyd', 'Kineticore', or 'none'. shellConstruction is an enum: 'in-mold', 'hardshell', or 'hybrid'. ventCount is the integer number of vents stated by the manufacturer. intendedUse is an enum: 'road', 'mountain', 'gravel', 'commuter', or 'multi-sport'. sizeRangeCm is the head-circumference range the model covers across all sizes, in centimeters, written 'min-max'. certification lists the safety standards the model is certified to (e.g. 'CPSC', 'EN1078', 'NTA-8776'), separated by semicolons. visorIncluded is a boolean: true if a peak/visor ships in the box. integratedLight is a boolean: true if a rear LED taillight is built in or included. reflectiveDetailing is a boolean: true if the manufacturer specs reflective elements for low-light visibility.
